{"task": {"role": "You read the description of an outfit and list its items as data.", "rules": ["One object per item — garment, shoes, bag, accessory, jewelry — in the order of the description, with its words and hex.", "One item carries one thing — of two alternatives list the first; a note in brackets is not an item.", "Slot "accessory" is for an item no other slot fits.", ""is_outfit" says whether the description is an outfit: no — when in place of items it has a refusal, a question or a note."], "limits": ["Rely only on the input: do not invent what it does not contain.", "The answer is one JSON object following "answer_schema", without explanations and without ```."], "language": "English", "answer": "ITEM_LIST", "answer_schema": {"is_outfit": "yes|no", "items": [{"name": "<what the item is>", "details": "<its cut, length and fabric>", "slot": "top|bottom|dress|set|outerwear|shoes|bag|scarf|headwear|belt|tights|socks|jewelry|earrings|collar_necklace|necklace|brooch|bracelet|ring|glasses|gloves|watch|swimwear|underwear|accessory", "color_hex": "<#rrggbb or null>", "worn": "<true, or false when the description says the outfit goes without it>"}]}, "input": [""description" — the outfit description"]}, "description": "Black wool-blend tailored blazer, sharp lapel, knee-length cut, black (#000000), structured weave.
Cream silk satin blouse, classic pointed collar, fitted through the torso to waist, cream (#f5f5dc), smooth fluid fabric.
High-waisted charcoal grey wool trousers, straight leg, full length reaching ankle bone, dark grey (#36454F), heavy drape with slight stretch.
Black leather Chelsea boots, round toe, mid-heel height, black (#1c1c1c), smooth calfskin.
Thin black patent leather belt, simple rectangular buckle, waist-length, black (#000000), glossy finish.

This outfit adheres strictly to the requested smart casual register while maintaining a restrained and classic aesthetic suitable for a Friday evening at a club. The tailored blazer and structured trousers provide a polished silhouette that stands out even when standing in a crowd, ensuring she feels confident without appearing overdressed for an indie rock setting. The mix of matte wool with the fluid silk blouse adds a subtle textural depth appropriate for artificial club lighting, while the black leather accessories ground the look and offer practical comfort for walking. By avoiding bright colors or overly distressed fabrics, this ensemble respects her wish for something streamlined yet stylish."}
